title: Reduced hypersurfaces through prescribed divisors of a normal surface
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The author bounds the number of divisorial components under small perturbations and chooses a perturbation maximizing that number. Carefully selected symbolic-power valuations then force every component multiplicity to one without introducing new components, producing a reduced hypersurface through all prescribed divisors.
